title: ClickEvent
description: Analytics event emitted for every successful URL redirect. Written to Kinesis, transformed by Firehose, and stored in S3 as JSON (partitioned by date). All PII is hashed before emission.

event_id.description: UUID (RFC 4122) that uniquely identifies this event across all pipeline stages. Generated at emission time.

schema_version.description: Schema version string. Increment when breaking field changes are introduced. Consumers must reject unknown versions.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the redirect in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-06-01T12:34:56.789Z).

tenant_id.description: Identifier of the tenant that owns the short link.

domain_id.description: Control-plane identifier of the domain entity. Used to join with the control-plane database.

domain.description: Hostname of the short link (e.g. go.customer.com). Normalised to lowercase with trailing dots stripped.

slug.description: Slug component of the short link (e.g. summer-sale). Normalised to lowercase with leading slashes stripped.

destination_url.description: Resolved destination URL. Includes any UTM parameters appended by link configuration.

status_code.description: HTTP redirect status code returned to the client.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code from the CloudFront-Viewer-Country header. Null when the header is absent.

region.description: ISO 3166-2 region subdivision code (e.g. CA-ON for Ontario, Canada). Populated when extended CloudFront geographic headers are forwarded.

city.description: City name as reported by CloudFront. Populated when extended CloudFront geographic headers are forwarded.

device_type.description: Device category derived from CloudFront viewer-type headers. Null when no viewer-type header is present.

browser.description: Browser family (e.g. Chrome, Safari, Firefox). Null when only the hashed User-Agent is available. Populated by downstream enrichment stages.

os.description: Operating system (e.g. Windows, iOS, Android). Null when only the hashed User-Agent is available. Populated by downstream enrichment stages.

referrer.description: Full Referer URL from the HTTP request header. Null when the header is absent.

utm_source.description: UTM source parameter configured on the short link (e.g. newsletter). Null when not configured.

utm_medium.description: UTM medium parameter configured on the short link (e.g. email). Null when not configured.

utm_campaign.description: UTM campaign parameter configured on the short link (e.g. summer24). Null when not configured.

bot_score.description: Bot probability score injected by AWS WAF via the X-Bot-Score header (0 = human, 100 = bot). Null when WAF inspection is not enabled.

latency_ms.description: End-to-end request latency in milliseconds measured by the Lambda handler. Null when not measurable (e.g. CloudFront log path).

ip_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the viewer IP address extracted from CloudFront-Viewer-Address. The raw IP is never stored. Null when the header is absent.

user_agent_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the User-Agent header value. The raw User-Agent string is never stored. Null when the header is absent.
